options.name: active_directory
options.description: Specifies whether the LDAP server is an Active Directory server

options.name: base_dn
options.description: Specifies the base DN for the LDAP search

options.name: bind_dn
options.description: Specifies the bind DN for the LDAP search

options.name: bind_password
options.description: Specifies the bind password for the LDAP search

options.name: bind_timeout
options.description: Specifies the bind timeout for the LDAP search

options.name: chase_referrals
options.description: Specifies whether to chase referrals during the LDAP search

options.name: idle_timeout
options.description: Specifies the idle timeout for the LDAP search

options.name: ldap_version
options.description: Specifies the LDAP version to be used for the search

options.name: read_timeout
options.description: Specifies the read timeout for the LDAP search

options.name: tls
options.description: Specifies whether to use tls for the LDAP search

options.name: tls_certificate
options.description: Specifies the TLS certificate to be used for the LDAP search Applies only when C(tls) is set to C(start_tls) or C(on).

options.name: tls_certificate_validation
options.description: Specifies whether to validate the TLS certificate during the LDAP search Applies only when C(tls) is set to C(start_tls) or C(on).

options.name: tls_ciphers
options.description: Specifies the TLS ciphers to be used for the LDAP search Applies only when C(tls) is set to C(start_tls) or C(on).

options.name: tls_key
options.description: Specifies the TLS key to be used for the LDAP search Applies only when C(tls) is set to C(start_tls) or C(on).

options.name: unix_attributes
options.description: Specifies whether to use Unix attributes for the LDAP search Unix attributes does not apply to Velos Partition.

options.name: update_password
options.description: C(always) will always update the C(bind_password) when it is specified. C(on_create) will only set the C(bind_password) when no bind password is currently configured on the device.
